class.name: SteamDlcInfo
class.brief_description: Detached metadata for a DLC entry in Steam's app catalog.
class.description: Get these records from a successful [method SteamApps.dlc] query. They describe the catalog at the time of the query.

method.name: get_app_id
method.description: Returns the Steam DLC AppID for this record.

method.name: get_display_name
method.description: Returns the display name copied from Steam.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns Steam's store visibility flag for this DLC.

members.member: Positive Steam DLC AppID for a catalog entry. An uninitialized record has AppID [code]0[/code].
Read-only Steam store visibility flag. Use [method SteamApps.owns_dlc] to query local ownership.
Read-only name copied from Steam's catalog. Steam can supply an empty name.
